title: SAFE-SVD: Sensitivity-Aware Fidelity-Enforcing SVD for Physics Foundation Models
abstract: arXiv:2605.17985v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We propose a new method for compressing physics foundation models (PFMs) which is a new trend in AI for Science. While model compression is essential for reducing memory use and accelerating inference in large foundation models, it remains under-explored for PFMs, where preserving physical fidelity is crucial. The challenge lies in the functional nature of physics data, where partial derivatives encode spatiotemporal dynamics and exhibit high sensitivity to compression. Conventional compression methods ignore this structure, often causing severe performance degradation or failure. To address this, we introduce a sensitivity-aware fidelity-enforcing compression framework that explicitly models loss-aware layer sensitivity in the output function space during compression. translated_title: SAFE-SVD：面向物理基础模型的敏感性感知保真度增强奇异值分解
translated_abstract: 摘要：我们提出了一种用于压缩物理基础模型（PFMs）的新方法，这是AI for Science领域的新趋势。虽然模型压缩对于减少大型基础模型的内存使用和加速推理至关重要，但在PFMs中，这一领域仍未被充分探索，因为保持物理保真度至关重要。挑战在于物理数据的函数性质，其中偏导数编码了时空动态，并且对压缩具有高度敏感性。传统压缩方法忽略了这一结构，常常导致严重的性能退化或失败。为解决这一问题，我们引入了一个敏感性感知的保真度增强压缩框架，该框架在压缩过程中显式建模了输出函数空间中损失感知的层敏感性。这为压缩科学基础模型同时保持准确性和物理保真度提供了一条新途径。实验表明，相对于现有方法，该方法取得了显著改进。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种敏感性感知的保真度增强压缩框架，通过显式建模输出函数空间中的损失感知层敏感性，在压缩物理基础模型时同时保持准确性和物理保真度，克服了传统压缩方法忽略偏导数结构导致性能退化的问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a sensitivity-aware fidelity-enforcing compression framework that explicitly models loss-aware layer sensitivity in the output function space, enabling compression of physics foundation models while preserving accuracy and physical fidelity, overcoming performance degradation from traditional methods ignoring partial derivative structure.
